results.summary_before: This project is a test harness for an OpenRAM SRAM macro (32x16) that communicates via UART, with separate address and data phases for read and write operations. It includes a DPU that can read, operate on, and write back data in the SRAM. Testing requires sending UART commands, ensuring the first command is sent only when uart_ready is high. Silicon tests confirmed random read/write functionality at 25 MHz and up to 75 MHz, with errors appearing at 100 MHz.

results.summary_before: This design is a structural 4x4 array multiplier that takes two 4-bit unsigned factors, m and q, on ui_in and produces their 8-bit product p on uo_out. It works by generating partial products and summing them with full adders in a classic array arrangement. Testing is suggested with a testbench of ten varying 4-bit factor pairs compared against their expected products. No external hardware is needed, and the design is a simple educational arithmetic block.

results.summary_before: This design implements a 4x4 array multiplier using structural logic, taking two 4-bit inputs m and q and producing an 8-bit product p. It uses a grid of AND gates and full adders to sum the partial products along diagonals. The design is purely combinational and is tested by applying an 8-bit input where the lower four bits are m and the upper four bits are q, then observing the product on the outputs. No external hardware is required.
